root_cause_rankings.cause: Stream publication is post-hoc, not claim-native
root_cause_rankings.evidence: m27_isolated_event_stream waits for worker completion before emitting verified_claim_ready/cited_segment_ready; this structurally ties first material latency to final latency.
Failure to produce a fully verified cited answer becomes continuation, safe terminal, or empty final; partial verified claims and precise gap causes are not surfaced.
Thin one-citation answers can be published, while answerable cases become safe/empty terminals. Product-depth and homepage-fit are not first-class gates before publication.
root_cause_rankings.support: Stage22 Owner 85 scoring and case matrix

root_cause_rankings.evidence: The owner-only product path grants 60s and 4 provider attempts; p95 final 44.9s and p95 first material 40.3s are unsurprising under this policy.

root_cause_rankings.cause: Evidence sufficiency is weaker than evidence validity
root_cause_rankings.evidence: Authority/binding checks validate provenance, but broad questions still receive one-source/thin answers or fail despite available evidence.
C15/C16 fail while related English topics are answerable; lexical-primary retrieval with dense disabled is brittle for cross-lingual queries.

root_cause_rankings.cause: Diagnostic receipts omit internal per-stage telemetry
root_cause_rankings.evidence: Comparator receipts preserve final/first material timings but not retrieval/provider/verifier micro-timeline per case, forcing root cause to be reconstructed from code and prior receipts.
